epics.title: Schedule canvas, Slots and Lists
epics.observations: Four items checked. FT-01.3 and US-01.6.3 (both Agreed) are Matches and I found nothing wrong in the code. The one real gap is the 26 Nov 'Intake as the front door' decisions (AR-72 points 9 and 10, cited by US-01.3.3, US-01.6.1 and US-02.1.2). The matching screen decides one hospital row at a time; there is no arriving-List unit. As a result, 'Create a Draft List' from Intake saves a Draft List holding only that row's Booking, whereas US-01.6.1's new AC says it holds its Bookings. That is why US-01.6.1 is corrected from Matches to Partial (M standalone, but it should be built with US-02.1.2's whole-List decision). The named-anaesthetist Slot suggestion (US-02.1.2 AC) is also absent: PdfListSample.target.anaesthetistId is only displayed in the PDF lists tab and the createList picker starts with no one chosen. US-01.3.3 stays Matches because its own text does not state the suggestion, but with medium confidence: if the owner reads 'placing an arriving List' as whole-List placement, it moves to Partial with US-02.1.2. Dependencies: US-02.1.2, US-02.1.4, US-01.4.2 and US-01.3.5 (both already built), FT-07.1 and US-13.5.2. Demo guide: the Intake script step (Okafor PDF, 'Create a List in a session', pick Rutherford) and the Draft List beats would change only if the rebuild preselects the named anaesthetist or builds the Draft List from the whole PDF. No seed or PERSIST_VERSION change is forced by these four items.

epics.title: Booking intake and change handling
epics.observations: All 16 gradings upheld after re-reading the code; no verdict changed. The prototype is at the pre-26-Nov intake reading (phases 33, 34, 40): intake is row-level and button-driven. Import hospital file, Upload PDF list and Send to matching are in-app actions, PDF lists and Waiting for NHI are separate tabs, the feed is a flat row table with no List or file grouping and no source filter, and every decision is per row (IncomingBookingFields cannot even name an anaesthetist). The catalogue now wants a List-level front door: arrivals appear on their own, grouped by List, decided as a whole List with the named anaesthetist's Slot suggested, with per-key match display and List versions, unchanged Lists confirmed in one click, removals offered from a re-sent PDF, and a Sources view. US-02.1.2, 02.1.3, 02.1.4, 02.1.6, 02.2.1 and 02.2.3 share one new List-level arrival and version model and should be one phase; US-02.1.1 and 02.1.5 (remove the import button, relabel the existing trigger) are a small independent S change that could land first; US-02.1.7 (Sources view) and US-02.6.3 (later NHI resolves a stub) build on that model. US-02.6.4 (stub guard in submitList and authoriseList plus a shown reason) is standalone and S. Already matching: FT-02.3 (admin entry), US-02.2.4 (List origin, incl. later-address rule), the stub placement and Add NHI resolution, procedure text as received, Draft List from intake, Reject, nothing applied until decided, and inbound-only behaviour (not stated in the UI). Size is per item, not additive. Dependencies: EP-11 (US-11.1.4/11.1.5 NHI waiting rows move from a tab into the feed filter), FT-02.5 (change types, procedure text US-02.5.7, cancellations from removals US-02.5.3), EP-14 (US-14.5.1 failure visibility feeds the Sources view; US-14.6.x future feeds), EP-01 (Draft List creation US-01.6.1), EP-07 (submit/authorise guard), US-02.3.3 and US-13.6.5 (reply to the List's sender), OQ-13 and OQ-124 (open, no grade impact). Demo-guide impact: S1 Beat 2 ('Import, then match', the PDF lists tab, Send to matching, the Open/Unmatched/Decided strip, the Waiting for NHI tab reading 1), the optional rooms re-send aside, the Diane Foster update beat, the handset stand-ins ('Hospital file imported and my booking matched', 'Office adds the NHI', which call importHospitalDownload/decideImportRow) and the /admin/intake/waiting and /admin/intake/pdfs routes all change; demoGuideSync.test.ts must stay green when trigger labels change.

epics.title: Anaesthetist profile and reporting
epics.observations:
All three gradings are upheld after re-opening the code. FT-12.1 is a pure Grouping. US-12.1.4 and US-12.1.6 both Contradict, because two older readings are implemented: the tier saves on click, and active is an immediate boolean that trims Slots from today. Each is large (size L) on its own.

Lane placement. The domain, store and sign-in half of US-12.1.6 fits Lane C in Wave 1, because it touches none of the Contracts-owned files. That half covers:
- a last-day date and reason on the Anaesthetist type;
- audited make-inactive, clear and make-active actions;
- Slots trimmed only after the last day;
- sign-in checked against the master record;
- own-Party Contracts disabled and offered back.
The new Anaesthetist fields need a PERSIST_VERSION bump and a seed review. Moving the tier into a card with the rate is also Lane C-safe as store and domain work. The per-card Edit/Save, the side panel and the People move itself need the record pattern lifted out of ContractCards.tsx and ProfileChrome.tsx, plus router/SideNav/masters redirect changes, so they wait for Wave 1 to join.

Interactions to coordinate:
- Disabling and re-enabling an anaesthetist's Contracts uses disableContract and enableContract from Phase 45. Phase 49 (Replace a Contract from a date) also changes Contract status, and the Contract identity there is linkedAnaesthetistId plus the holder Party.
- The shared anaesthetistSession.ts is in the PWA closure and must stay pure (pwaPurity.test.ts). Reading active from the master record therefore needs a small injected check or a store-side hook, not an import from the store.
- OQ-147 and OQ-83 are open, so departed-anaesthetist remittance access stays narrated.
- The Anaesthetists list also needs search, tier filter and paging, which are absent today.

Demo guide: S1 to S5 do not use make-inactive or the tier control, so the impact is additive (a new beat on the demo clock). The Dr Sharma record path in the guide changes with the People move, which is for the sweep.

epics.title: Admin oversight and master data
epics.observations: All six items graded on code re-read. The prototype has every underlying screen (Billing monitor, Invoices, Ledger, payment cycle, AA fees, Xero queue and divergence panels, reconciliation status) but no Finances container: grep for 'finances' in aa-prototype/src finds nothing, and the side nav has Invoices, Billing monitor and Ledger as three items. The work is structural. First, a Finances section with six routed tabs (Billing, Invoices, Payments, Ledger, Xero, AA fees), tab counts and one warning badge, keeping the old /admin/invoices, /admin/billing and /admin/ledger addresses resolving. Second, the monolithic BillingMonitorScreen must be split: the Xero queue and divergence panels go to Xero, PaymentCyclePanel and the payment-run pages to Payments, AaFeePanel and AaFeesScreen to AA fees, and HoldingAccountPanel to the Ledger list. Third, the Billing tab gets rebuilt as the Problems-first option C table (List heading with Bookings as rows) with Problems/In progress/Done/All filters, search and a fix-the-payer action, which needs a new failure path (payer with no billing email) in the domain, store and seed. Fourth, the Ledger loses the Whole ledger / One anaesthetist switch and gains the four-figure header, a three-way list and per-anaesthetist rows that open account pages. Two items are Contradicts (US-13.2.1 and, corrected from Partial, US-13.3.1) because the prototype implements designs the catalogue now says were considered and not kept. OQ-149 (where an unplaceable receipt is placed) is open and touches the Ledger place/refund actions, the receipts-to-place figure and the reconciliation unresolved items, so build those provisionally. US-13.2.4 is Proposed and waits on the posting design (clearing account, sub-ledger against control account), which the code header says is deliberately not modelled. Demo triggers: billing-failure and arm-handoff-fault (screen BILLING_MONITOR_SCREEN), xero-outage and inject-unmatched-receipt (screen 'Admin · Ledger') are keyed by screen and must be re-pointed at the new tab routes; add 'Payer loses billing email' for the fix-the-payer beat, and optionally 'Leave money in clearing account' on the Day screen if the extra reconciliation checks are built. Demo-guide impact (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md): S3 Money end to end (Billing monitor, AA fee invoices and Ledger beats, plus the direct-URL table) and S4 Exceptions (Holding account card, billing failure, Xero outage, changed-in-Xero, refund after payout, payment week) change navigation and wording; the Ledger beat changes most. The demoGuideSync test, capture recipes and ATLAS belong to the owner's sweep, not this work. Read-only; no files modified.

items.requirement_says: From the anaesthetist's page the office makes them inactive by choosing a last day and a reason. Until that day nothing changes. After it they have no Slots, are not offered or picked (assignment, availability finder), cannot sign in, and their own-Party Contracts linked to them are disabled. History stays readable. It is refused while they hold a List after the last day (those Lists are shown). The last day can be cleared before it arrives. After the last day they can be made active again (Slots from that date, sign-in restored, disabled Contracts offered ticked with price and re-activated). Make inactive, clear and make active are each audited.

It refuses with listsAhead ('N Lists from today. Reassign them first.') when any List is from today onward. Inactive anaesthetists are skipped in the roster, finder, draft-list candidates, move targets and the pairing add sheet. disableContract and enableContract exist but are not linked to the anaesthetist. The anaesthetist app sign-in is a per-browser localStorage flag (shared/session/anaesthetistSession.ts) that never consults masters.anaesthetists[].active. dataModelDeltas.title: The arriving List is what the office decides
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: For each List that arrives, the office decides the whole List at a time: its changes apply together and any one Booking's change can be left out. The feed groups rows by List (a hospital file is a heading over its Lists, a PDF is one List) with filters By source, Needs NHI and Decided. Lists that match with no differences are shown as unchanged and confirmed together by a person in one click.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: The unit is a row. ImportBatch holds rowIds; each ImportRow has its own status (open|applied|rejected) and one ImportDecision (match, createBooking, createList, createDraft, reject) made by decideImportRow one row at a time. A List appears only as RowAssessment.targetListId; counts are of rows; an unchanged row is its own decision. A Decided filter exists today but over rows. There is no leave-out outcome and no confirm-all-unchanged action. The surgeon is a per-row correction (ImportRowCorrections.surgeonId), not a List choice.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Derive the arriving List (rows of one arrival sharing hospital, day, session, surgeon as sent; an unrecognised surgeon is chosen once for the List). Add a List-level decision as one change set: apply ticked rows, place the whole List in one Slot holding every row's Booking, reject the whole List, confirm unchanged Lists as a person's act. Leave-out needs an outcome that is decided but changed nothing: either a reject carrying a fixed 'left out' reason (cheapest) or a new ImportDecision member (clearer in Decided and the audit); without one the row hangs. Counts and the stats strip move from rows to Lists; Intake's attention count still counts each waiting-NHI row once, so its unit needs one stated rule. Unchanged Lists only exist in the feed if DM-21 stops skipping identical re-arrivals. Must precede DM-12, DM-13, DM-17, DM-19, DM-21 and the Intake screen rebuild. Same lane as DM-15. Bump PERSIST_VERSION only if the seed carries decided rows (it does not today).
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Catalogue and prototype claims hold. Corrected: leave-out does not strictly need a new union member (reject already decides a row and changes nothing), the surgeon becomes a List-level choice, and the unchanged-List display depends on the new DM-21.

dataModelDeltas.title: A List keeps its versions, and a match shows its keys
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A match shows each key and whether it agreed (surgeon, hospital, day and session, and how many patients were found by NHI), with no score; the List's earlier versions (where it first came from and each later arrival) and its Slot. The hospital's List for the same surgeon, hospital, day and session as a List the rooms sent is proposed as an update to it, not a new List.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: A List remembers only its first source (ListOrigin). The matcher already finds the List by hospital, day, session and surgeon then the patient by NHI (findMatch, basis listAndPatient) but returns one MatchBasis per Booking with no record of which keys agreed or the NHI count. The only version link is PDF to PDF (SurgeonPdfList.replacesId, our reading). A hospital row for a rooms-made List already matches Booking by Booking at row level; nothing lists the List's earlier arrivals. A match decision names a Booking, not a List.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Two pure reads: matchKeys(arrivingList) and listVersions(state, listId) built from decided rows (match, createBooking, createList) plus open rows targeting the List, across both sources. One stored gap: a match decision does not name the List and a Booking can later move Lists, so record listId on the match decision (optional field, no bump). Needs DM-11. No new entity.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Both sides re-read and hold; noted that the matcher already uses the keys, so only exposing their results and the NHI count is new.

dataModelDeltas.title: Bookings missing from a re-sent List are offered as removals
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A re-sent rooms' PDF for a List AA holds is merged as its next version; each Booking on the List that is missing from it is offered on the matching screen as a removal the office confirms as a cancellation or leaves out. In the first release (was Future Work).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Not built. A re-sent PDF stages only changed rows against the earlier sent list; the code states 'A patient left off the re-sent List is not detected (US-02.2.3, Future Work)'. A cancellation arrives only as an explicit row with hospitalStatus 'cancelled'. Booking.source (BookingSource, incl. surgeonPdf) is already stored.
dataModelDeltas.impact: On arrival of a rooms' PDF for a held List, each non-cancelled Booking whose patient is not among the PDF rows becomes an offered removal. Cheapest shape: stage a synthetic cancellation row per missing Booking (hospitalStatus cancelled, source rooms, carrying the Booking's NHI) so confirm is today's match+cancellation decision and leave-out is DM-11's outcome; the alternative is a stored offer record. Which Bookings count as 'on the List' needs no new field: Booking.source (surgeonPdf) and the decided rows' source say which the rooms brought. Open: whether hospital re-sends do the same and whether a left-out removal is re-offered by the next re-send. Needs DM-11.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Catalogue holds (US-02.2.3 is MVP lane, not Future Work). Corrected: the Booking's source is already stored, so no new field is needed to scope the check.

dataModelDeltas.title: A source is an entity with a state
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A second matching-screen view lists each source (each connected hospital and the rooms' mailbox): whether it is receiving, when it last sent, messages today and what each became, anything unreadable or held with the reason; sources not connected are listed as such; the view states AA only reads and never writes back.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: No source record. IntegrationFeed (three Future-scope simulator feeds: St George's, Christchurch Public, Southern Cross) holds only a field mapping; IntegrationMessage is the HL7/FHIR simulator log at /demo/integrations and is the one existing arrival with a recorded outcome (status, attempts, resultImportRowId, failureReason). The rooms have no record by design and a mailbox has no equivalent. Batches carry hospitalId and channel but no source identity.
dataModelDeltas.impact: A small seeded list of sources (St George's, Southern Cross, the rooms' mailbox, plus unconnected hospitals such as Christchurch Public) with stored connected/receiving state the demo can switch; last sent, messages today and what each became are derived from arrivals (DM-15), held from DM-16's reason. The simulator's message path is the model for the derived measures but stays Future-scope: generalise it through DM-15's arrival record rather than widening IntegrationFeed. US-14.5.1 (retry and alerting) is Future Work and out of scope; only the held reason of US-02.1.7 is. Needs DM-15, DM-16 and DM-21; seeded slice bumps PERSIST_VERSION.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Claims hold. Corrected: US-14.5.1 is Future Work (context only, dropped as a requirement ref), and the feed-message path is prior art for what-each-became and held-with-reason.

dataModelDeltas.title: Rows arrive by source, not by an office import
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Hospital rows reach the matching screen as each hospital sends them and PDFs are read from the office's mailbox as they arrive; nobody imports or uploads. A PDF that reached someone's own inbox can be added by hand with its sender. Nothing is applied silently and AA never writes back. Replaces the 18 November answer to OQ-109.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Every arrival starts with an office act: importHospitalDownload is office-only and stamps ImportBatch.importedBy with a person (button 'Import hospital file'); a PDF is uploaded by an office user with a typed sender (SurgeonPdfList status 'received', own PDF lists tab) then sent to matching in a second step. Channel 'manualSheet' (Forte Health no-NHI sample, PWA office stand-in) has no catalogue source. No arrival exists that produced no rows (a batch is made only when fresh rows exist). Arrival-shaped demo triggers already exist (receiveTheatreList, receiveResentPdfList) but run as the office actor; the Forte sheet trigger calls importHospitalDownload. PDF row corrections allow ethnicityCode but ImportRowCorrections does not.
dataModelDeltas.impact: An arrival becomes a record made by a source actor (actor source 'integration' exists), carrying its source and time, existing even with zero rows. ImportBatch.importedBy becomes the source (a person kept only for a PDF added by hand). The received/sent two-step collapses: PDF rows land on arrival and the office corrects on the row; ImportRowCorrections must take ethnicityCode and the from/to/who/when history PdfRowCorrection keeps. SurgeonPdfList becomes the PDF attachment of the arrival or folds into it. Import, upload and send actions go; existing arrival-shaped triggers change actor and label and the Forte trigger is re-pointed. manualSheet: keep as demo-only (sample and PWA stand-in use it) or move them to download. Persisted intake slice changes shape: bump PERSIST_VERSION. Must precede DM-14; same lane as DM-11. Removing the Waiting for NHI, PDF lists, Data quality and Validators tabs edits router.tsx/routes.tsx that the Finances Wave 5 lanes also edit.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Catalogue and core prototype claims hold. Corrected: arrival-shaped demo triggers already exist (change is actor and label), the simulator is prior art for an integration-actor arrival, and the PDF-to-row collapse would lose the ethnicity correction.

dataModelDeltas.title: A PDF is read with a confidence for each value, and one that cannot be read is held
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: The office sees the PDF beside the values read from it; each value shows how sure the reader was, an unsure value is marked for checking and shows where it sits on the page. A PDF that cannot be made into a List still lands in the feed with the reason, never dropped. How it is read is the development team's choice.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: PdfRowAsRead holds plain values and the wording with no confidence or location. The PDF is a generated SVG data URL (facsimile) already shown as an image beside the rows as read, but only on the PDF lists tab before send, not on the matching screen. Reading problems are only invalid or missing NHI. Every PDF yields rows, so there is no unreadable PDF. The per-value confidence design exists only as the exploration docs/explorations/intake-ideas.html.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Each read value carries {confidence, where (page, box)} with a check threshold; the simulated reading is set by the sample data. The existing facsimile image moves to the matching screen beside the values with a highlight box (the generated image must place each value so the box lands on it). A PDF with nothing readable is a zero-row arrival with a held reason (DM-15) shown in the feed and under its source (DM-14). PdfRowCorrection history and verbatim wording unchanged. Persisted shape: bump with DM-15.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Catalogue holds. Corrected: the PDF is not a text string but an image that already sits beside the values one screen earlier; the real gaps are confidence, location, matching-screen placement and the unreadable case.

dataModelDeltas.title: A stub is resolved by a later arrival that carries the NHI
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: When a later arrival for the List (usually the hospital's) carries the NHI of a patient whose stub is waiting, the update shows the NHI and applying it turns the stub into the Booking. Adding the NHI by hand stays the one manual way.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: A stub is tied to its waiting row (Stub.importRowId) and settles only when that row is decided or its Draft List goes; resolveStub addNhi is the only route. A later row carrying the NHI has a different duplicate key (NHI vs name|dob in rowPatientKey), is not linked by earlierOpenRow, finds no Booking (a stub is not one), and would be proposed as a new Booking while the stub stays standing.
dataModelDeltas.impact: A stub's matching identity is its List plus the patient's name and birth date as received. An arriving row for that List with the same name and birth date is proposed as an update to the stub's row (new suggestion kind or row flag showing the NHI it adds); applying adds the NHI to the waiting row and decides it in one commit so the Booking takes the stub's place, with settleStubForRow called for the stub's row. Ambiguity (two stubs fit) is the office's choice. No new stored field. Needs DM-11.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Re-read both sides; the failure path is confirmed in matching.ts and stubActions.ts.

dataModelDeltas.title: A List holding only a stub cannot be completed or authorised
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A List whose only line is a stub never reads complete and can be neither submitted as completed nor authorised until the stub is resolved or rejected, with the reason shown to whoever tries. A List that also holds Bookings is never held up by its stub.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Stubs live in the intake slice and are not read by the lifecycle. submitList refuses only incomplete Bookings, so a List with no Bookings and one stub submits and can then be authorised; listProgress returns 'upcoming' for a List with no Bookings, which hides the case in screens without refusing it. The shared SubmitListSheet lists blockers per incomplete Booking only.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Refuse in submitList and authoriseList, and add a blocker in authoriseBlockersFor, when the List has a standing stub and no non-cancelled Booking; show the reason from one place: the Review screen and SubmitListSheet (which needs a List-level reason line, as it would otherwise show an empty list). A lifecycle block, not a warning rule, because the catalogue says 'can be neither'. Lifted by resolving or rejecting the stub or the List gaining a Booking; no stored state. Standalone; can run any time.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Catalogue and lifecycle claims hold. Corrected: names the shared SubmitListSheet as the place needing a List-level reason.

dataModelDeltas.title: An arrival names the anaesthetist it was meant for, and a new List is placed with that Slot suggested
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: For an arriving List AA does not hold, the Slot of the anaesthetist the PDF or hospital List names is suggested when free; the alternatives are another anaesthetist's free Slot or a Draft List. Placing from Intake is the same act as manual assignment.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: IncomingBookingFields has no anaesthetist. A PDF names one only at list level (SurgeonPdfList.target.anaesthetistId) and pdfRowIncoming drops it when staging rows. openSlotsForRow lists every open Slot for the day and session and the panel offers the free anaesthetists with no suggestion; the createList decision carries only the chosen slotId.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Optional anaesthetist {name, hpiId?} on the incoming fields, resolved to the master like resolveSurgeon, so PDF and hospital Lists can name one; the arriving List's read gives the suggested free Slot first and the alternatives after. Optional field needs no PERSIST_VERSION bump alone. Whether hospital rows carry an anaesthetist depends on the open format question OQ-13; the demo hospital samples gain the field. Needs DM-11.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Re-read both sides; holds as drafted.

dataModelDeltas.title: A payer with no billing address fails the Booking, with its reason and fix
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A Booking whose payer has no billing email shows its reason under the patient's name with a fix-the-payer action beside it on the Billing tab; an admin fixes the payer and retries and the Booking bills and leaves Problems. Billing fails one Booking at a time and a Booking whose billable party fails is held whole with none of its invoices issued.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: A payer with no address does not fail the run: the invoice is raised and stamped not sent with reason noAddress (audit invoice.notSent), awaiting a typed address. Phase 59 added only the code payerNoAddress and the Mark-resolved fields (resolvedBy, resolvedNote); nothing raises the code.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Decided, not open: D116 (ROADMAP, a plan default on Phase 60's owner-review list) has the run fail the Booking whole as a BillingException with payerNoAddress and no invoice, pair or Xero hand-off; Fix the payer edits whoever is billed and Retry (retryBillingException) bills it. The raised-but-unsent alternative is closed. Changes the billing run, retryBillingException, the seed's failure examples and every noAddress reader; no new stored field beyond Phase 59's. Owned by Phase 60 (Wave 5, Lane A); standalone.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Catalogue and code claims hold. Corrected: the choice the draft called open is already decided as D116 and owned by Phase 60.

dataModelDeltas.title: Identical re-arrivals are shown as unchanged Lists, not skipped
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Lists in an arrival that match what AA holds with no differences are shown as unchanged and confirmed together by a person in one click; they stay waiting until a person confirms. Nothing that arrives is silently dropped, and the sources view shows messages today and what each became.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Staging drops what it has seen: stageImportRows skips a row equal to an open row or to the patient's latest earlier row at that hospital, day and session, counts it in ImportBatch.skippedCount, and makes no batch when every row is skipped. A re-sent identical hospital List, or a re-sent PDF with no change (sendPdfListToMatching stages only changed rows), leaves no trace in the feed. An unchanged row exists today only when a hand-made Booking matches a first-time row.
dataModelDeltas.impact: All of an arrival's rows are staged, including those identical to the last arrival; the matcher already classifies a matched row with no differences noChange, so an unchanged List is a List whose rows are all noChange and DM-11's one-click confirm decides them. The duplicate key keeps only its earlierRowOpen job. skippedCount goes or becomes the unchanged count; the sources view (DM-14) reads what each became from rows that now exist. Open for the owner: whether an identical daily re-arrival whose earlier rows are all decided still asks for a confirm (the stories say unchanged Lists wait for a person). No stored field; intake counts and the demo triggers' 'already received' refusals change. Needs DM-11; touches the same staging code as DM-15.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Missed by the author, who assumed unchanged rows already reach the feed; found in stageImportRows' dedupe.

deltaSummary:
Verification is done and docs/build-plan/analysis/domain-model-delta.md is updated to match. No delta was refuted. Every catalogue claim holds against the stories and note points, and none rests on a retired story or the Future Work lane. Every prototype claim was re-read in code. I corrected 7 deltas, upheld 3 unchanged (DM-12, DM-17, DM-19) and added 1 (DM-21). The file now has 11 open deltas, DM-11 to DM-21, with a Verified line under each.

**Corrected**
- **DM-11:**
  - Leave-out does not strictly need a new union member. `reject` already decides a row and changes nothing, so a reject with a fixed reason is the cheapest shape; a member of its own is clearer.
  - The surgeon is a per-row correction today. It has to become a List-level choice for a List-level place action.
  - The unchanged-List display depends on DM-21.
- **DM-13:** No new stored field is needed to say which Bookings the rooms brought. `Booking.source` already holds `surgeonPdf`, and decided rows carry their source.
- **DM-14:** US-14.5.1 is Future Work, so it is context only. The simulator's feed-message path (`integrationActions.ts:246`) already records what each message became and why it failed, which is a model for the derived measures.
- **DM-15:**
  - Arrival-shaped demo triggers already exist (`receiveTheatreList`, `receiveResentPdfList`), but they run as the office actor. The change there is the actor and the label.
  - `manualSheet` is also used by the PWA office stand-in.
  - Folding the PDF row corrections into `ImportRowCorrections` would lose the ethnicity correction, which the PDF path allows and `ImportRowCorrections` does not.
- **DM-16:** The PDF is not a text string. It is a generated SVG image already shown beside the values, but on the PDF lists tab before send, not on the matching screen. The real gaps are per-value confidence and location, placement on the matching screen, and the unreadable-PDF case.
- **DM-18:** The shared `SubmitListSheet` lists blockers per incomplete Booking only. It needs a List-level reason line, or it shows an empty list for a stub-only List.
- **DM-20:** The choice the author called open is already decided as D116 in `docs/build-plan/ROADMAP.md` and owned by Phase 60. The raised-but-unsent invoice alternative is closed.

**Added**
- **DM-21:** `stageImportRows` skips rows identical to ones already seen and makes no batch when every row is skipped. An identical re-sent List therefore never reaches the feed as an unchanged List, so US-02.1.6 has nothing to show or confirm. The author's DM-11 assumed unchanged rows already arrive.

I also added DM-21 to the order of work (with DM-11) and to DM-14's needs.
